_notes: Admitted vs enrolled: Ukrainian 'зараховано' is the official act of enrolment (наказ про зарахування), so it is reserved for Enrolled (common:appStatus.ENROLLED, university:af.stepName.ENROLLED already use it). Admitted (offer made/accepted) is now 'Прийняті' in agency:today.phase.admitted, agency:v22.stage.admitted, university:v22.stage.admitted and university:stage.ADMITTED; university:v22.stage.enrolled 'Вступили' became 'Зараховані'. This matches the existing university:v22.in.q.admit ('Кого приймають і хто зараховується?').

Waiting-on vocabulary (glossary 'waiting on' for consoles) unified as 'Чекають на …' (cases waiting on a party): students.view.waiting_*, v22.work.col.waiting, v22.work.anyWaiting. 'Очікування на' was dropped.

University review stage unified as 'Розгляд в університеті' (agency:v22.stage.review, v27.stage.REVIEW, common:appStatus.UNIVERSITY_REVIEW); consultation stage = 'Консультація' (v22.stage.counselling had 'Консультування').
Admission guide (the university's official document list) = 'правила прийому', following the already-reviewed agency:v27.guide.missingTitle; 'guide wording' = 'формулювання з правил прийому'.

'Verify' as the reviewer's action stays 'Підтвердити' (docs.sc.verify, bulkVerify) while the resulting status is 'Перевірено' (common:docStatus.VERIFIED); 'Request correction' = 'Запросити виправлення' to pair with 'Надіслати запит на виправлення'.

Ukrainian plurals: _few/_many added (and _other corrected to the fractional form) for every {{count}} key: dash.days, misc.days/hours, docs.bulk*, docs.sub, inbox.subReply/subUnread/unreadN/willNotify, savedViews.saveHint, students.bulk.*, students.dShort, today.docsSla, today.pipelineSubV4, today.v5.andMore/writingRevised, v22.team.count, v22.work.confirmOwner/total/upcoming, v22.ws.docFix/docReview, v23.work.submissionsNeed, v27.hq.waiting, waiting.reason.*, ws.block.deadline/review, ws.itemsInReview/itemsRemain, university:applicants.customStatus/requested. university:applicants.requested_one had dropped the noun ('Запитано: 1'); restored.

agency:ws.assignedBy + ws.by.*: rendered as 'Призначення: <nominative source>' (алгоритм підбору / адміністратор / операційний відділ Hangyul (вручну) / покупка послуги) so the fragments do not need case agreement.
Pipeline (agency) = 'етапи' ('воронка' is kept for the university funnel only). Caseload = 'ваші студенти' / 'у вашому веденні' (no CRM calque).
Service period (glossary) = 'період обслуговування'; add-on in the agency console = 'додаткова послуга' (glossary: 'additional service'); 'Active (legacy)' = 'Активна (стара схема)'.
Korean visa categories kept official: D-2/D-4 (university:af.stepDef.VISA_ISSUED). CHSI kept as the official Chinese verification name.
